name: WirePhys
description: Representation of a single interaction of the WirePM type, storage for relevant parameters

attributes.name: initD
attributes.description: Equilibrium distance for particles. Computed as the initial inter-particular distance when particle are linked.

attributes.name: isLinked
attributes.description: If true particles are linked and will interact. Interactions are linked automatically by the definition of the corresponding interaction radius. The value is false if the wire breaks (no more interaction).

attributes.name: isDoubleTwist
attributes.description: If true the properties of the interaction will be defined as a double-twisted wire.

attributes.name: displForceValues
attributes.description: Defines the values for force-displacement curve.

attributes.name: stiffnessValues
attributes.description: Defines the values for the various stiffnesses (the elastic stiffness is stored as kn).

attributes.name: plastD
attributes.description: Plastic part of the inter-particular distance of the previous step. .. note:: Only elastic displacements are reversible (the elastic stiffness is used for unloading) and compressive forces are inadmissible. The compressive stiffness is assumed to be equal to zero. ..

attributes.name: limitFactor
attributes.description: This value indicates on how far from failing the wire is, e.g. actual normal displacement divided by admissible normal displacement.

attributes.name: isShifted
attributes.description: If true WireMat type=2 and the force-displacement curve will be shifted.

attributes.name: dL
attributes.description: Additional wire length for considering the distortion for

attributes.name: shearForce
attributes.description: Shear force after previous step (in global coordinates), as sustained by particle #2 (from particle #1).

attributes.name: normalForce
attributes.description: Normal force after previous step (in global coordinates), as sustained by particle #2 (from particle #1).

attributes.name: dispIndex
attributes.description: Return class index of this instance.

methods.name: dispHierarchy
methods.description: Return list of dispatch classes (from down upwards), starting with the class instance itself, top-level indexable at last. If names is true (default), return class names rather than numerical indices.

methods.name: updateAttrs
methods.description: Update object attributes from given dictionary
